highlights: Usage now shows an estimated cost for Gemini (Antigravity) turns.
Queued messages show Steer only for providers that can steer a running turn, so Steer no longer fails for Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline and custom agents.
The model picker shows the Gemini models also when Gemini starts slowly.
The activity line now says when the agent waits for your answer or approval.
Server settings › Storage no longer shows machine use and alerts for now.
